value.answer: Soccer: I'd go with Messi. Most recent coverage lands there too. As of May 2026 he has 8 Ballon d'Or wins to Ronaldo's 5 and more career assists (408 to 261). Ronaldo has more career goals (970 to 906), so it's not a blowout. American football: Tom Brady, for the seven Super Bowls, though Brady himself has said Jerry Rice is still the GOAT.
